source_citation: Raven, Peter H. 1969. A Revision of the Genus Camissonia (Onagraceae). Contributions from the United States National Herbarium 37:161-396.
support_basis: multiple diploid and tetraploid populations were tested by pollen-tube growth and found self-compatible
taxonomic_note: Camissonia californica is the synonym used by Raven 1969; the currently accepted analysis name is Eulobus californicus.
reason: The recovered Meyer residual encoded SI, but Raven's species monograph reports direct pollen-tube compatibility tests across multiple diploid and tetraploid populations and classifies the species as self-compatible. The newer Onagraceae monograph likewise lists E. californicus as self-compatible.
